dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast horizontal light edges visible as repetitive scalloped patterns across the greater and median coverts, appearing as stacked pale bands against dark feather centers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, prominent pale linear boundaries along the edges of the folded primary and secondary flight feathers.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive and highly regular scalloped pattern covering the entire dorsal area, created by high-contrast dark centers and light gray-white margins.
